_comment: Stealth tuning (src/systems/stealth/). Edit and refresh the page; no code changes needed. Distances are in tiles (16 px), angles in degrees, times in seconds. cone.widthDeg is the full angle; camera.sweep is relative to the camera's mount direction (it starts at fromDeg). detection: fill time is linear from fillSecondsNear at distance 0 to fillSecondsFar at the cone's length; decaySeconds is full to empty. player.sprintMultiplier multiplies the existing walk speed (Player.js PLAYER_SPEED). noise.walkNoise is 'none' or a ring radius in tiles. rays: rays cast across each cone. render.maxConesPerFrame caps how many cones are redrawn each frame.
